patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Gong and LinkedIn Sales Navigator share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Frame: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Gong and LinkedIn Sales Navigator share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.. Choose Gong only if your buying job matches “Conversation intelligence / revenue AI — per-user licenses + platform fee; custom proposal” rather than LinkedIn Sales Navigator's shape. Choose LinkedIn Sales Navigator only if your buying job matches “LinkedIn’s AI-powered B2B sales tool for network prospecting, Buyer Intent, and InMail — C” rather than Gong's shape. Workflow advantage: Gong leans sales-engagement; LinkedIn Sales Navigator leans prospecting. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Gong and LinkedIn Sales Navigator share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Gong is Conversation intelligence / revenue AI — per-user licenses + platform fee; custom proposal only (no public dollar list).; LinkedIn Sales Navigator is LinkedIn’s AI-powered B2B sales tool for network prospecting, Buyer Intent, and InMail — Core from US$119.99/mo; Advanced Plus for CRM sync..
- Company-size focus: Gong (mid-market, enterprise) vs LinkedIn Sales Navigator (micro, small-business, mid-market).
- Workflow coverage skew: Gong-leaning sales-engagement vs LinkedIn Sales Navigator-leaning prospecting.
- Researched limits: Gong — Separate job from sales intelligence contact databases; LinkedIn Sales Navigator — Not a B2B email/phone contact database — InMail is designed to work without contact info.

Limitations — Gong: Separate job from sales intelligence contact databases; Not a prospecting/enrichment data core; LinkedIn Sales Navigator: Not a B2B email/phone contact database — InMail is designed to work without contact info; No bulk InMail; messages are individual with monthly InMail credits (50/mo stated on plans).

Poor-fit cases: Gong is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Separate job from sales intelligence contact databases · LinkedIn Sales Navigator is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Not a B2B email/phone contact database — InMail is designed to work without contact info · Avoid Gong if you actually need LinkedIn Sales Navigator's motion (LinkedIn’s AI-powered B2B sales tool for network prospecting, Buyer Intent, and )

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
